mvp_scope: Cover 1-2 highest-signal dispute types first (e.g., e-commerce return/exchange dispute + gym-membership refund) to limit legal-content scope
Guided intake → AI classification → document checklist + drafted complaint text for the correct free government channel
Explicit 'informational only, not legal advice' framing throughout

regulatory.requirement: Law Practice System (نظام المحاماة): pleading/representation before courts and formal legal consultation is restricted to licensed lawyers registered with the Saudi Bar Association — a tool that drafts legal complaint text risks being characterized as unauthorized legal practice if it strays from pure information/template assembly into advice or representation
PDPL applies to dispute data collected (financial/tenancy/personal details) — consent, minimal retention, and data-subject rights needed
Freelance license/CR + Maroof for payment acceptance

data_dependencies: Underlying regulation text (Ejar rent-freeze rules, CST complaint procedure, MoC return-policy rules) changes over time (e.g., 2025 Ejar updates) and must be manually tracked/updated by the founder — no official API feed exists
No public API to auto-submit to Najiz/Ejar/CST/Balagh Tijari; user must self-submit, limiting the tool to document-prep only
blockers: Ambiguous legal boundary between 'informational document assembly' and 'unauthorized legal practice/consultation' under نظام المحاماة — needs careful product framing and ideally a legal opinion before launch

Underlying government complaint channels (Najiz, CST, Balagh Tijari, CPA) are free, so willingness-to-pay for a document-prep layer is unproven (no payment evidence found, only complaint/confusion evidence)
Multi-domain scope (rental, gym, e-commerce, delivery) each has its own evolving rules — content-accuracy maintenance burden is nontrivial for a solo founder without legal training
results.summary: Technically a moderate AI+RAG build (6-8 weeks), but the real risk is regulatory/legal positioning (practicing-law boundary) plus unproven monetization against free official channels. Recommend narrowing to 1 dispute type and strict 'template, not advice' framing before any wider build.
